pairs.subject: multi-provider-gateway-plane
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/llm-config.ts:370 This context only resolves configuration for kp's own outbound LLM calls: one provider per use case, serialized into an env var for kp's own Python subprocess. It has no candidate tree, no failover loop, no response normalization and no stream framing, and none of its callers are outside kp's control. A case-insensitive search of app/_lib for event-stream, finish_reason, stop_reason and fallback_chain found nothing.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/llm-config.ts:370 Routing is a flat use-case-to-one-provider map, not a tree of strategies with inherited policy.

app/_lib/llm-model-defaults.ts:47 OpenAI-compatible servers are reached by a base URL the operator types in, under a provider the operator also chooses. Nothing is discovered, so the plane never has to work out which implementation it is talking to.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:5 The TS layer hands config to a subprocess and never reads a provider stream.
